name: InterContinental Minneapolis – St Paul Airport
positioning: Airport hotel at Minneapolis-St. Paul International Airport with direct access to Terminal 1 and an on-site TSA checkpoint, runway- and skyline-view rooms and suites, a penthouse-level event space looking over the Minnesota River Valley, and La Voya, a French brasserie with Minnesotan influences
best_for: Travelers flying through MSP who want direct access to Terminal 1 and an on-site TSA checkpoint
Aviation fans who want a room with a runway view

facts.text: The MetroTransit Light Rail Blue Line serves the hotel as public transportation.
Rooms offer a separate work area with an executive desk, a spa-inspired shower and luxury linens.
The Wingspan Suite may include skyline and runway views and a separate bath and walk-in shower.
The penthouse-level Altitude event space offers views of the Twin Cities.
The Passport Ballroom has vast ceiling heights and crystal teardrop chandeliers.
Mall of America is about 6 miles from the hotel.
The hotel has a 24-hour business center.
Self parking is in the parking ramp adjacent to the hotel, and valet parking is at the main entrance.
Pets are welcome, limited to dogs and cats.
Bradstreet Craftshouse is a gaming hall with gastropub favorites, crafted cocktails, a wide beer selection and interactive entertainment.

highlights.text: The hotel offers direct access to Terminal 1.
The hotel has an on-site TSA checkpoint.
The penthouse-level event space offers a 180-degree panorama of the Minnesota River Valley with views of both the Minneapolis and St. Paul skylines.
Premium Rooms may include a runway view from two windows.
La Voya Brasserie serves traditional French dishes infused with Minnesotan influences.

considerations.text: The hotel does not have a pool.
WhataHotel notes potential aircraft noise due to the hotel's proximity to runways.
